readings.title_en: How to make a fruit salad
text_en: A fruit salad is easy to make, and it's very healthy.
First, wash your hands and put on an apron.
Then wash the fruit: two apples, a banana, a kiwi and some grapes.
Ask an adult to help you with the knife.
Peel the banana and the kiwi, and slice them on a chopping board.
Chop the apples into small pieces.
Put all the fruit into a big bowl.
Next, add some orange juice and a teaspoon of honey.
Finally, put the bowl in the fridge for ten minutes.
